units.source_text: ……这时候，我觉得阳光仿佛从云隙流泻下来似的，也许这是我的错觉。

en.t: ... At that moment, I felt as though sunlight were pouring down through a break in the clouds; perhaps it was only my illusion.

units.source_text: 但是，寂静的公园全景的构图产生了不谐调，

en.t: But a discord had arisen in the composition of the silent park's whole panorama,

units.source_text: 包围着我们的汪明的画面，那些松林、河流的闪光、远方的群山、洁白的岩石、星星点点的杜鹃花……

en.t: in the bright, clear scene surrounding us: those pine woods, the glitter of the river, the distant mountains, the white rocks, the scattered azaleas...

units.source_text: 这些充满了画面的各个角落，令人感到细细的龟裂走遍了整个画面。

en.t: All these filled every corner of the scene, making it feel as if fine cracks had spread across the entire picture.
